Thanks Camila — appreciate the follow-up and the attachment.

A couple quick notes:
- Our security team prefers the SIG/CAIQ format; full SIG is ideal but we typically triage the Data Protection, Encryption, and Access Controls sections first.
- We will need a SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 summary that indicates the period covered. Can you confirm Redwood’s SOC 2 status?
- AcmeHealth processes PHI in a few integration flows, so HIPAA controls and BA agreement readiness are important. I’m CC’ing our SecurityOps alias (security@acmehealth.com) and Tom Rivera (our vendor integrations lead) so they can confirm scope.

Proposed timeline: initial responses to priority sections by next Friday (2026-07-10). Does that work?

Best,

Thanks Alice — and hi Tom.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the period ending 2026-03-31. I’ve attached a one-page SOC 2 summary; we can provide the full attestation under an NDA/procurement portal.
- HIPAA/PHI: We support HIPAA-regulated customers via our Private deployment and BAAs. I’ll flag Marissa to coordinate BAA/legal touchpoints.

Per your prioritization request, we’ll focus first on: Data Protection, Encryption, and Access Controls.

Questions from our side to confirm scope:
- For evidence attachments, do you want PDFs of our policies and the SOC summary attached to the SIG spreadsheet, or should we provide links to a secured folder?
- For log retention and masked logs: do you need sample logs or a statement of what we redact by default?
- Is there a preferred place to upload the completed SIG (vendor portal vs. email)? If vendor portal, please send the portal invite or upload instructions.

We’ve set an internal target to have initial answers to the three priority sections by 2026-07-09 so there’s room for your review before 2026-07-10.

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Camila. A few clarifications from security: 

- Confirmed priority: Data Protection, Encryption, Access Controls. Full SIG is great but those three are blocking for our initial pilot.
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary PDF is fine to start; our legal team will request the full report and a BAA if PHI is in scope. Please connect Marissa with our legal lead (I’ll share contact details once I have permission).
- Logs: we need a brief statement on what fields are redacted/masked in application and audit logs and the default retention period for logs and KV caches.
- Encryption: please confirm KMS options (customer-managed KMS / HSM support) and TLS cert handling for private deployments.

Can we do a 30-min sync next Tuesday 2026-07-06 at 10:00 AM ET to walk through these priorities? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.
